subject: Report builder losing custom formulas on refresh
body: Custom formulas in three of our recurring reports get wiped every time the underlying data refreshes, forcing us to rebuild them each week. This is eating hours we don't have before year-end reporting.

subject: Re: formulas wiped — still happening, now worse
body: Following up on the formula issue from last week — it's still happening, and now it's affecting five reports instead of three. We're a week from year-end close and rebuilding formulas manually every refresh isn't sustainable.

subject: Formula issue is back — thought this was fixed in December
body: This is the exact same formula-wipe problem from December, which we understood was resolved. It's now Q1 close and I'm again rebuilding formulas by hand. I need to understand why a 'fixed' issue keeps coming back.

subject: Alerts not firing for budget variance
body: Configured a budget variance alert weeks ago and it has never triggered despite clear breaches in April. Combined with the still-unresolved report builder problem, our reporting reliability has taken a real hit this year.

subject: Escalating — report builder formula issue never actually resolved
body: Coming back to this because it's never gone away — the formula-wipe issue we first raised in December is still happening, on and off, ten months later. I'd like this properly escalated with an engineer who can look at root cause, not another config check.

subject: Escalating — seat provisioning broken for a month
body: We've had a new hire unable to get proper report-builder permissions for almost a month now despite three tickets. Between this and the ongoing formula issue, I'm asking for a call with someone senior on your side this week.

subject: Re: seat provisioning — thanks for the call
body: Appreciate the call and the fix that followed — the new hire is fully provisioned now. Will be watching to make sure it holds.

subject: Formula issue — finally seeing this hold
body: It's been a month since the fix and the formula-wipe issue hasn't recurred once, including through two refresh cycles. Genuinely relieved to see this actually stick this time.

subject: Report builder — small formatting request
body: Since things are stable now — any chance of adding a way to lock column widths in a report so they don't reflow on refresh? Nice to have, not urgent.

subject: Report builder — template library question
body: Is there a shared template library we can build up across the finance team, so people aren't recreating similar reports from scratch each quarter?

subject: Adding a seat for new controller
body: Adding a new financial controller to the team next week — please provision a Professional seat with report-builder access.

subject: Seat role adjustment
body: Could you adjust one of our existing seats from viewer to editor? Role changed internally, needs updated access.

subject: API returning stale cache
body: The reports API is returning data that's clearly a day old even though the dashboard shows current numbers. Is there a cache layer we need to bypass with a header or parameter?

subject: Export missing latest month
body: Monthly export is consistently missing the most recent month's data until several days into the new month. Timing seems off somewhere in the pipeline.

subject: Report builder — formula errors since API fix
body: Since the API cache issue was patched, several report builder formulas that reference API-sourced fields are now throwing errors. Feels like the fix broke something else.

subject: Report builder still broken — third ticket on this
body: Same formula errors as last month, still unresolved. This is the third ticket on report builder in six weeks and it's affecting a report going to our board next week.

subject: Escalating — dashboards down for exec team
body: The executive dashboard set has been down or showing errors intermittently for two days, right as we're heading into board week, on top of the still-unresolved report builder formula issue. I need this escalated and a status update by end of day.

subject: Report builder — escalation, formulas STILL broken
body: Following up on the escalation — dashboards are stable now but the underlying report builder formula issue from January has never actually been fixed, just worked around manually every cycle since. This needs proper root-cause attention.

subject: Dashboards — confirming the fix held
body: Wanted to confirm the dashboard stability fix from the escalation has held through two full board cycles now. Good to have this one closed out.

subject: Alerts — thanks, config change applied cleanly
body: Appreciate the quick turnaround on the alert config change we discussed. Working exactly as expected.

subject: Admin — adding two seats for new analysts
body: Bringing on two new analysts next month, please provision Enterprise seats with dashboard and report builder access.

subject: Report builder — formulas holding steady, one small ask
body: The formula issue really does seem behind us now — several months clean. Small ask: could conditional formatting rules be copied between reports rather than rebuilt each time?

subject: Report builder — template versioning question
body: Is there any version history on report templates? Would be useful to roll back if someone accidentally overwrites a shared template.

subject: Date filter not working as expected in custom report
body: The date filter on my custom report defaults to 'this month' when I open it, even though I saved it with a specific date range. Is there a way to lock the filter so it doesn't reset? It's a small thing but people keep running the report with the wrong period.

subject: Intermittent 401s — key unchanged
body: Sporadic 401 errors, key hasn't changed, works then fails then works again. No time-of-day pattern. Gaps in our pipeline.

subject: Alerts stopped sending emails — still no fix on API issue either
body:
Our alert notifications stopped arriving by email about a week ago. The alerts show as triggered in the platform but nothing lands in the inbox. We've checked spam filters. Nothing.

Also — I raised an API authentication issue on July 1st and it's still unresolved. The intermittent failures are continuing. I'd appreciate some actual progress on both of these.

subject: API auth failures — still seeing them
body: Following up again on the 401 errors from the API. The alerts email issue was fixed, thank you. But the API problem continues. At this point I've logged this three times. If the answer is that we need to re-issue the key or change something on our end, just tell us and we'll do it. We just need it to work consistently.

subject: API rate limit documentation — where to find current limits
body: Where can I find the current API rate limits for our plan tier? We're seeing slower response times lately and want to check if we're close to any limits before investigating further. The documentation page I bookmarked seems outdated.

subject: API pagination not returning complete dataset
body: When fetching large result sets via the API using cursor-based pagination, we're getting duplicate records across pages and some records appear to be missing entirely. We've checked our implementation against the documentation and it looks correct. Reproducible with our events endpoint. Please advise.

subject: Need to transfer admin access to new IT contact
body: Our previous admin contact has moved to a different role. I need to transfer the admin account to myself. Old admin email: jonne.makinen@[company].fi. Please confirm the process. I'm the new IT contact going forward.

subject: PostgreSQL connector sync failing after DB upgrade
body: We upgraded our PostgreSQL instance from 13 to 16 last weekend and the Kataja data connector has been failing to sync since then. Error in the sync log: 'SSL connection required'. Our DB does require SSL but as far as I can tell the connector was working fine with SSL before the upgrade. Has something changed in how the connector handles the SSL handshake? We need this fixed — it's our primary data source.

subject: API response latency — p95 has doubled in the last two weeks
body: We monitor our API response times and the p95 latency has roughly doubled in the past two weeks. We haven't changed our call patterns. Is there something going on infrastructure-side? Still also waiting on the data connector SSL issue — nothing back from support on that yet.

subject: Bulk export failing for datasets over 500k rows
body: Bulk exports are failing with a timeout error for any dataset over approximately 500,000 rows. We export to CSV for our data warehouse pipeline. This used to work fine. The export starts, runs for a few minutes, then returns a generic error. We have no way to get the full dataset out right now and the connector sync is still broken too. Two major data paths are down simultaneously.

subject: Alert emails going to spam / not delivered
body: Alert notification emails are being caught by our spam filter. IT says the sending domain isn't on an allowlist and the DKIM records look suspicious. Can you provide the SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration we should whitelist? We've missed several alerts because of this.

subject: API field naming changed in response — breaking our parser
body: Something changed in the API response format. The field 'created_at' is now 'createdAt' (camelCase). This is breaking our parser. Was this in a changelog somewhere? We didn't get any notice. Going forward, is there a way to receive advance notice of breaking changes? We need at least a deprecation period.

subject: Scheduled export not running — second time this month
body: Our scheduled daily export didn't run again last night. This happened earlier in December too. The job shows 'queued' and never moves to 'running'. We've tried cancelling and re-scheduling. Same result. We need reliable automated exports — this keeps falling over.

subject: Webhook endpoint documentation — is it current?
body: We're looking at using the webhook integration for real-time event triggers. The documentation page shows an endpoint structure that doesn't match what we're seeing in the actual API explorer. Which is correct? Before we build anything on top of this we need to know the documentation is reliable.

subject: Dashboard — adding a comparison period
body: Is it possible to show a comparison against the same period last year directly on the dashboard tile, rather than as a separate chart?

subject: Admin — SSO setup question
body: Looking into enabling SSO for the account — what identity providers are currently supported?

subject: Export — scheduling to a shared drive
body: Can scheduled exports be delivered directly to a shared drive or SFTP location instead of email attachments?

subject: Export — recipient list management
body: Is there a way to manage the recipient list for a scheduled export in bulk, rather than adding people one at a time?

subject: Alerts — cooldown period between triggers
body: Can we set a cooldown period so an alert doesn't fire again for the same condition within, say, 24 hours? Getting a bit of repeat noise.

subject: Data connector — read replica support
body: Does the Postgres connector support pointing at a read replica rather than the primary, for load reasons on our end?

subject: Report builder — conditional visibility on sections
body: Can a report section be hidden conditionally based on a filter value, similar to conditional formatting on cells?

subject: Admin — audit log export
body: Is there a way to export the admin audit log for our internal compliance review, or is it view-only in the portal?

subject: Data connector — adding a second warehouse region
body: We're adding a second data warehouse hosted in a different region — any latency considerations we should know about before connecting it?

subject: Removing a departed contractor's access
body: A contractor's engagement ended this week — please remove their seat and confirm they no longer have access.

subject: Year-end seat review
body: Doing our year-end review — could you send a current list of active seats and their roles so we can confirm everything matches our records?

subject: API — export endpoint for month-end automation
body: Looking to automate our month-end pack using the API — is there an endpoint that returns a finished export file directly, or do we need to trigger and then poll?

subject: How to add a calculated percentage column to a table report
body: I'm building a financial summary table and want to add a column that shows each row's value as a percentage of the total. I can see how to add a calculated field but I'm not finding a way to reference the grand total as a denominator. Is there a built-in function for this or do I need a workaround?

subject: Deactivating a user and freeing the seat
body: One of our team members left last week. Can you confirm that deactivating the user in Admin will release the seat for reassignment? I've deactivated the account but the seat count in billing doesn't seem to have changed. Want to make sure before I invite a replacement.

subject: PDF export — header logo not showing
body: When exporting reports to PDF, our company logo isn't appearing in the header even though it's been uploaded in the branding settings. The preview in the Report builder shows the logo correctly but the exported PDF doesn't. Has something changed, or is there a separate setting for PDF headers I'm not aware of?

subject: Report template — how to lock certain fields from editing
body: We have a standard monthly P&L report template that several analysts use. I want to lock specific fields and filters so that users can run the report but can't accidentally change the structure. Is there a way to protect or lock elements within a report template?

subject: Dashboard not refreshing automatically despite auto-refresh setting
body: We have auto-refresh set to 15 minutes on our main overview dashboard but it doesn't appear to be refreshing. The 'last updated' timestamp stays the same until we manually reload the page. Users have noticed the dashboard is showing stale data in meetings. Can you check if there's an issue with the auto-refresh functionality?

subject: Alert configuration keeps reverting to old settings
body: I updated several alert thresholds last week and they keep reverting to their previous values after a day or so. I've saved the changes and see them reflected initially, but then they change back. This is the third time I've had to redo this. Something is overwriting my changes — is there a sync issue or a background process resetting configurations?

subject: One-time scheduled export possible?
body: Need a one-off full export Jan 1 at 06:00 for year-end. Is one-time scheduling possible, or scheduler only for recurring?

subject: Alert settings reverting AGAIN — this is the fourth time
body: The alert threshold revert issue I reported on 19 December was supposed to be fixed. It has happened again. Four times now. The thresholds I set are not being saved persistently and I have no confidence they are working correctly. This is a fundamental problem. We rely on these alerts for financial monitoring — if they're silently using wrong thresholds we could be missing real events. Please escalate this.

subject: Alert issue still open — no update in a week
body: I escalated the alert configuration revert issue on January 1st. It is now January 8th and I have not received any update. The problem is still occurring. I've had to disable the alerts entirely because I can't trust them. Please respond.

subject: API — fetching alert configuration via API endpoint
body: We're looking at managing alert configurations programmatically via the API to avoid the issues we've had with the UI reverting settings. Is there an API endpoint for reading and writing alert configurations? The documentation mentions it but I can't find the actual endpoint definition. Please point me to the right place.

subject: Custom date range not persisting across report sessions
body: When I set a custom date range on a report and share the link, recipients see the default range instead of the one I set. Is the date filter included in the shareable URL, or is it stored separately? This is causing confusion because colleagues open the same report link and see different data.

subject: SSO setup — SAML configuration not completing
body: We're trying to configure SAML SSO with our Azure AD tenant. I've followed the setup guide but I'm getting an error at the final step: 'Metadata URL validation failed'. The URL is reachable from our side. Is there a known issue with Azure AD SAML metadata, or is there a format requirement I might be missing? Happy to share the metadata URL if it helps.

subject: Alerts arriving 2-3 hours late
body: KPI alerts arriving 2-3 hours after trigger. Useless for same-day action. Some kind of batch delivery on the backend?

subject: User access audit — can we export a log of login activity?
body: Our IT security team needs a log of user login activity for the past 90 days for an internal audit. Can we export this from the Admin panel, or do we need to request it from support? We're on Professional tier — is this included in our plan?

subject: Bulk export jobs hanging indefinitely
body: Bulk export jobs are getting stuck in 'processing' state indefinitely. They don't fail, they just never complete. We've had three jobs stuck for over 24 hours now and we cannot get our data out. This is actively blocking a deliverable. We need someone to look at this today — cancelling and restarting the jobs doesn't help, they get stuck again in the same state.

subject: API returning 500 errors on data write endpoints
body: We are getting HTTP 500 errors on POST requests to the data write API. GET requests are working fine. This started yesterday afternoon. Our write pipeline is completely broken. Ticket raised because this is a production incident — we need a response within the hour. Error details: endpoint /api/v2/events, payload is standard JSON, nothing changed on our side.

subject: Alert delivery — still delayed, following up
body: The alert delivery delay issue we reported in February was supposed to be fixed. We're still seeing delays, now up to 90 minutes in some cases. I've stopped relying on the alerts for anything time-sensitive. Just logging this again formally. At this point I'd find it helpful to understand whether this is going to be a persistent limitation or whether there's a real fix coming.

subject: Dashboard widgets showing 'data unavailable' after connector issues
body: Several widgets on our main dashboard are showing 'data unavailable' following the API issues from August. The underlying connectors appear to be syncing again but the widgets haven't recovered. Do we need to manually refresh something, or is there a cache issue on the dashboard side? Please advise on how to restore the affected widgets.

subject: Budget threshold alerts silent since January
body: Set up alerts for budget threshold breaches at the start of the month and haven't received a single one, despite two departments clearly over budget already. Can you check the config on your end?

subject: Re: budget alerts — still nothing
body: Following up on Erik's ticket from last month — alerts are still not firing. We've now missed a full month of the visibility this feature is meant to give us.

subject: Report builder — budget report totals wrong
body: The budget vs actual report is showing totals that don't match the underlying data by a meaningful margin. Given the alerts have also been broken, I'm starting to wonder if there's a deeper data issue.

subject: Alerts firing on the wrong threshold
body: Alerts are firing now but at the wrong threshold — set to 90% of budget, firing at 100%. Second config-related alerts issue in two months.

subject: Escalating — alerts unreliable for four months running
body: This is the fourth ticket on alerts since January — silent, then wrong threshold, and now firing twice for the same event. I'm escalating this because budget alerting is core to why finance uses this platform, and right now we can't trust it.

subject: Re: escalation from May — alerts issue is back
body: Coming back to the escalation from the spring — alerts had been quiet for a while but this week they've started duplicating again, exactly like the February issue. Please treat this as a continuation of the open escalation, not a fresh ticket.

subject: Admin — seat access following the alerts fix
body: Thanks for finally getting to the bottom of the alerts issue. Separately, could you check why one of our seats lost access to the budget dashboards during the recent changes?

subject: Report builder — confirming stability
body: Wanted to confirm the budget report totals have matched the source data for two consecutive close cycles now. Good to see this holding after everything this year.

subject: API — access to alert history
body: Now that alerts are reliable, is there an API endpoint to pull alert trigger history for our own audit trail?

subject: Admin — bulk role update
body: Need to update roles for six seats after a small reorg — is there a bulk option or do we need to do it individually?

subject: Dashboards — adding a new department view
body: Could you help us set up a new dashboard view for a department that was recently split out? Happy to share the structure we're after.

subject: Question on API authentication token expiry
body: We're setting up a new integration that pulls data via the API into our internal reporting tool, and I wanted to confirm how long authentication tokens are valid before they need refreshing. Is there a way to extend the expiry window, or should we build in an automatic refresh on our side? Also curious whether there's rate limiting we should design around from the start rather than discover later. Thanks in advance, Hanna

subject: Dashboards loading slowly since last week
body: Since around the 12th of March, our main dashboards have been noticeably slower to load, sometimes ten to fifteen seconds where it used to be near-instant. It's not affecting every dashboard equally — the monthly summary view seems worst. Could you check whether something changed on our account recently, a new data source or widget perhaps? It's a minor irritation for now but enough that a few colleagues have commented on it unprompted. Let me know what you need from our side to investigate. Hanna

subject: Same dashboard slowness as March — hasn't really gone away
body: Coming back to this one — the dashboard loading issue we raised back in March was marked resolved at the time, but the slowness has crept back in over the last few weeks, and if anything it feels worse than before. We've had two people separately ask whether the finance dashboards are 'broken again'. Given how often this keeps recurring, our head of ops has also asked us to have a look at Dashlume as part of a general review of our reporting tools next year. I'd still like this properly fixed if possible, though. Hanna

subject: Connector sync gap over the weekend
body: We noticed a gap in our connector sync history over the weekend of 12–13 July — no runs logged at all rather than a failed run, which is a slightly different symptom to what we usually see. Could you confirm whether there was scheduled maintenance on your end during that window? We didn't lose anything critical since the Monday sync caught up, but wanted to flag it given everything else we've had with dashboards this year. Still keeping half an eye on Dashlume as an alternative, for what it's worth. Hanna

subject: Removing a departed colleague's seat
body: One of our analysts left the company last month and I'd like to remove her seat and reassign her saved reports to me, please. Nothing urgent — she's already offboarded from our systems, so this is just tidying up the licence count on our end. Could you also confirm whether unused seats roll over or whether we're paying for them either way until the next renewal? Thanks, Hanna

subject: Dashboard performance — still on and off since the spring
body: Following up on the dashboard slowness we've mentioned a couple of times now, since March and again in June — it's still intermittent, still unresolved in any lasting way, though we've largely adapted by scheduling exports overnight and working from those instead of the live view. No need to prioritise this on our side; the workaround holds up well enough for our monthly reporting. We are due to review our BI tooling ahead of next year's renewal, and Dashlume has come up again in those conversations, mostly on the strength of dashboard responsiveness. Just keeping you posted. Hanna

subject: Setting up KPI threshold alerts — configuration question
body: I'm trying to set up threshold alerts on a few KPIs but I can't find where to define the alert condition against a specific metric value. The Alerts module seems to be set up around connector events rather than report metrics. Are KPI threshold alerts supported, and if so where do I configure them? Happy to provide more detail on what we're trying to monitor.

subject: Dashboard not displaying correctly on mobile
body: Our team needs to view the main dashboard on mobile (mainly iOS Safari). The layout is breaking — widgets overlap and the charts aren't readable. Is there a responsive mode or a separate mobile view we should be using? Or is mobile not fully supported?

subject: API timing out on 90-day queries
body: Requests for ~90 days of daily data time out on /reports/data, smaller ranges fine, within documented limits. Pagination approach, or a timeout to adjust?

subject: Alert not triggering — threshold crossed but no notification
body: Following up on my August ticket about alert configuration — we did eventually get the alerts set up with help from support. But now one of the alerts isn't triggering. The monitored metric clearly crossed the threshold yesterday (I can see it in the report data) but no notification was sent. The alert is set to 'active'. Can you check if there's a delivery or evaluation issue?

subject: Connector still down — three weeks
body: Connector's been down since Jan 8. Two tickets, same questions, no fix. Need someone with real authority today.

subject: Connector still down — no fix after 5 weeks
body: Five weeks since the connector failure. The 'fix' deployed last week didn't work — the connector ran once and then failed again with the same error. I have given up expecting this to be resolved through the normal ticket process. Our data is still stale. Please escalate to your engineering team directly and give me a named engineer who is responsible for this.

subject: API for pulling historical connector sync logs
body: Is there an API endpoint for pulling connector sync history and error logs? We want to build our own monitoring so we have earlier warning of sync failures rather than finding out when the data in reports is stale. After what we went through in January and February, we're not relying on the built-in monitoring alone.

subject: Invite sent but user not receiving email
body: I sent an invite to a new team member (k.virtanen@[company].fi) but they're not receiving the invite email. It's not in their spam folder. The user shows as 'Invited' in our admin panel. Can you resend or check if there's a delivery issue on your end?

subject: Role permissions — can Editors share reports externally?
body: Quick question: can users with Editor role share reports with people outside our organisation, or is external sharing restricted to Admins? I can't find a clear answer in the documentation and I want to set the right permissions before onboarding the rest of the team.

subject: MySQL connector timing out on one table
body: One 8M-row table times out after ~40 min every sync. Batch size option isn't available for MySQL. Workaround?

subject: Cross-source report showing stale data
body: Report joining two connectors doesn't always pick up new syncs, shows previous sync's data. Cache refresh issue?

subject: MySQL connector timeout — still not resolved after March ticket
body: The MySQL connector timeout on our large table was marked as resolved in March but the issue has come back, possibly after a platform update. The same table is timing out again. The root cause was apparently never properly fixed — we just had a period where it happened to work. I need this escalated. This table is central to our reporting and sync failures mean our dashboards are showing stale data.

subject: Multiple dashboards showing stale or missing data
body:
Following on from the connector issue — several of our dashboards are now showing stale data or 'data unavailable' errors. The connector sync failure is clearly propagating through to the dashboards. Three dashboards that the operations team uses daily are affected.

I understand the connector issue is being worked on but the dashboard failures feel like a separate problem that could be addressed in parallel — for example, clearer error states rather than silently showing old data. I've now raised multiple issues over several months and resolutions have been slow and sometimes not permanent. Can we get a dedicated account contact?

subject: Export job queued for 12 hours — not running
body: I triggered a manual export yesterday afternoon and it has been in 'queued' state for 12 hours. No error, just stuck. There are no other jobs running that I can see. Can you check whether there's a queue issue and clear this job? We need the data for a report due today.

subject: Scheduled export missing runs — again
body: Our daily scheduled export missed two runs this week (27 and 29 August). The schedule is set to 06:00 daily. No error reported, the jobs just didn't run. This has happened intermittently since July. We have a workaround of triggering manual exports but that defeats the purpose of scheduling. Please investigate whether there is a recurring infrastructure issue.

subject: Scheduled export still missing runs — September
body: Three more missed export runs in September (10th, 17th, 24th). Same pattern as August. The ticket I raised last month was closed but the problem clearly wasn't fixed. I'm logging this again for the record. We cannot rely on scheduled exports for our reporting pipeline at this point.

subject: API endpoint for triggering manual export
body: Given the ongoing issues with scheduled exports, we want to trigger exports via the API as part of our own scheduler so we have better control and visibility. Is there an API endpoint for initiating an export job and checking its status? Quick question — documentation pointer would be sufficient.

subject: API — intermittent timeouts on report endpoint
body: Getting intermittent timeouts calling the reports endpoint, maybe one in five requests. Doesn't correlate with payload size as far as we can tell. Any known issue?

subject: Re: API timeouts — workaround needed
body: Following up on Tuomas's ticket — the timeouts are still happening and it's forcing our team to pull numbers into Excel manually as a stopgap for this week's reporting. Would appreciate a fix or at least a workaround soon.

subject: Alert — recipient group not receiving digest
body: One of our alert recipient groups stopped receiving the weekly digest a couple of weeks ago, though individual alerts still come through fine. Could you check the group config?

subject: Transferring account ownership
body: Our previous admin has left the company — need to transfer account ownership and primary billing contact to me. What do you need from us?

subject: API — key rotation process
body: What's the recommended process for rotating our API key without breaking the existing integration mid-cycle? Want to do this without downtime.

subject: Alerts — great feature, one question
body: The new budget alert has been really useful since we set it up. Quick question — can the recipient list differ per alert rule, or is it account-wide?

subject: API — access for a new BI tool pilot
body: We're piloting a lightweight BI tool alongside Kataja for one team and want to pull data via your API into it. Is that something you support, and are there any restrictions we should know about?

subject: Exports — request for scheduled Excel with formatting
body: Loving the export options so far. Would it be possible to preserve cell formatting, colors, bold headers, in scheduled Excel exports rather than plain data? Would save our team a manual step every week.

subject: Data connectors — request for HubSpot connector
body: Any plans to add a native HubSpot connector? We currently have to route through a workaround and it would simplify things a lot on our end.

subject: Alerts — thanks for the recipient-per-rule option
body: Saw the recipient-per-alert-rule setting landed — thank you, that answers the question from earlier in the year and works perfectly.

subject: Report builder — new template looks great

subject: API — getting started, which endpoint for dashboard list
body: Just starting to explore the API — which endpoint would give us a list of all dashboards and their IDs so we can start scripting against them?

subject: API — auth token scope question
body: Our API token seems to only have read access to some dashboards but not others, even though the user has full access in the UI. What determines the token's scope?

subject: Dashboard — resizing tiles
body: Is there a way to resize dashboard tiles freely, or are they locked to preset sizes? Trying to fit more on one screen for a wall display.

subject: Dashboard — wall display auto-refresh
body: Setting up a dashboard for a wall display and want it to auto-refresh every few minutes without anyone touching it. Is there a kiosk mode or similar?

subject: API — rate limit for our size plan
body: Following on from the wall display setup — if we also poll via API for a secondary screen, what rate limit applies on the Standard plan?

subject: Dashboard — kiosk mode cycling through views
body: Following up — is there a way to cycle through multiple dashboards automatically on the wall display, or does kiosk mode only support one view at a time?

subject: Nested IF returning null in report builder
body: Hi, running into an issue with a nested IF formula in a calculated field — the third condition returns null instead of falling back to the else branch. Report ID RB-4471. Not urgent, just want the logic to actually match the documentation.

subject: Bulk seat reassignment
body: We're reshuffling a few analyst seats after a team change. Is there a bulk way to reassign seats to new users rather than removing and adding one by one? About ten seats.

subject: Scheduled export to SFTP instead of email
body: Right now our scheduled exports land in inboxes, which means someone has to manually drop the CSV into our warehouse folder. Any plan to support SFTP as an export destination? Would save us a manual step every week.

subject: Rate limit on /reports endpoint
